page_title: MAL 3-0 OVI | Mallorca v Oviedo 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
90+2' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

90+2' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Horatiu Moldovan allowed him to make a comfortable save.
89' The current number of corner kicks is 4:5. The fouls committed statistics – 10:8.
88' 3 - 0 Goal! 3:0. The ball rebounds to Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
88' Half-chance! Jan Virgili (Mallorca) plays a pass into the box, but Horatiu Moldovan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
85' Martin Demichelis has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Olaizola (Mallorca) replacing Toni Lato.
85' Substitution. Pablo Torre will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).

83' 2 - 0 Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:0.
80' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
77' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to substitute Nacho Vidal and he is replaced by Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo).
77' It's time for a substitution. Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) comes on in place of Rahim Alhassane.
76' The referee blows for a cooling break.

75' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
74' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Mallorca are awarded the free kick.
71' A long pass finds Pablo Torre (Mallorca), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Horatiu Moldovan reacts well to make a good save.
70' 17:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
67' Pablo Torre sends the corner to the centre of the box where Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) leaps highest but pushes his header well wide of the left post.
67' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

66' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) will replace Santiago Colombatto.
63' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) replaces Santi Cazorla.
62' Martin Demichelis prepares a substitution. Samu Costa is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
61' Substitution. Jan Virgili (Mallorca) in, Takuma Asano out.
60' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) takes it short.

59' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Oviedo can continue in their attacking effort.
58' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
58' The Oviedo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
55' What an opportunity! Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) surprised the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from long range. Unfortunately for him, the ball only crashed against the right post!
53' Martin Demichelis is forced to make a change. Omar Mascarell is unable to continue due to injury, Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) comes on.
52' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
50' Dani Calvo (Real Oviedo) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
50' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
50' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Oviedo will have an opportunity.
49' The attendance is 19311.
48' The free kick is taken by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo), but ball is cleared.
48' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
47' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves makes a half-time substitution. Haissem Hassan comes on in place of Alex Fores (Real Oviedo).
46' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
45+2' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45+1' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

42' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Pablo Torre (Mallorca) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Pablo Maffeo. The score is now 1:0.
42' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
41' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

40' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
40' Half-chance! Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) plays a pass into the box, but Leo Roman reacts well to snuff out the attack.
37' This is a yellow card! Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
37' Vedat Muriqi plays a short pass through to Takuma Asano (Mallorca) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post.
37' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
36' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Oviedo win a corner.
34' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:3. 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
30' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
29' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

28' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) whips the ball into the box and Takuma Asano takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Mallorca hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
24' Horatiu Moldovan makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) after a cross from the side.
22' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a long ball forward to Takuma Asano, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
21' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
19' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
17' Golden chance! Takuma Asano (Mallorca) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
17' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 67:33.
14' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the middle of the net, but Leo Roman makes a decent save to stop the effort.
14' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

14' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Oviedo force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Dani Calvo (Real Oviedo) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
11' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
10' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
9' Lovely cross from Sergi Darder to find Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) deep in the box, but he steers his header well wide of the left post.
8' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

6' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) produces a towering header after the corner kick. He could have scored, but one of his own teammates gets in the way of the ball and unintentionally changes its direction. The score doesn't change.
6' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
5' The ball is cleared after Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
1' Toni Lato (Mallorca) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
